name: manual_e58908
claim: The GossipBus insert_event canonical return is a 4-tuple of row_id, event_uuid, safe_payload, inserted. The inserted boolean is True for fresh rows, False for duplicates when INSERT OR IGNORE hit. Callers must check inserted before calling schedule_embedding so duplicate forwarded events skip embedding to avoid redundant work.

decisions.notes: Discovered in PR #211: All callers of insert_event (agent_coordination.py, lan_gossip_bridge.py, fastapi_app.py) must unpack the 4-tuple and check inserted before schedule_embedding.
